Each line is a date the record committed to. On or before it, open the
ticket's log, read the watch's exit condition, and rule the watch with a
CLOSED ledger line. A re-review that finds no new observable closes with
the acceptance recorded in its closing note. Undated watches are not on
this calendar: give each its date with a RE-ANCHORED line.
